findings.evidence: Version B has both 129_civilization_kernel.sql and 129_longitudinal_mission_evidence.sql while the runner tracks only filename/applied_at.
findings.impact: Migration ordering remains deterministic but identity is ambiguous for audit and already-applied content changes.
